messages:
Nina: Quick review: the 'Rollback preview' drawer shows a diff peek but keyboard users can't open the file diff without a mouse. We should surface keyboard affordances.
Sam: I saw that. The diff peek only opens on hover or click on the tiny chevron. Propose adding a dedicated 'Open diff' button per changelog line that is focusable.
Pradeep: If we add many focusable controls, tab bloat will be an issue. Maybe make the whole changelog entry focusable and use Enter/Space to expand the diff inline. That keeps tab stops low.
Nina: Good call. For screen reader announce, when the diff expands we need an aria-live message: "Showing changes for file X, 12 lines added, 3 removed".
Asha (PM): UX copy: current drawer title "Rollback preview" feels scary. Ops suggested "Preview changes before rollback" which is more explanatory. Thoughts?
Sam: I like the explicit phrasing. Also the tooltip on rollback CTA reads "Rollback" which lacks context. Change to "Rollback active deployment to vX.Y.Z" and include changelog summary.
Pradeep: Accessibility nit: the inline diff uses green/red color only. Add +/- markers and ensure contrast for additions/deletions. Also merge collapse/expand state into aria-expanded on the entry button.
accessibility-bot: Scan results: ensure expanded diff container has role="region" and aria-labelledby referencing the filename heading. Announcements should be polite and debounced (250-400ms). Color-only indicators must have text or icons.
Nina: Also keyboard shortcut request from Eng: allow 'D' to toggle diff when focused on a changelog item and '?' to open a keyboard help modal. We should reserve single-letter shortcuts with modifiers for discoverability (e.g., Ctrl/Cmd+D).
Sam: Agreed. Add a small tooltip "Press ⌘/Ctrl+D to open diff" on focus for power users. Ensure modifier-handled shortcuts are skipped on text inputs.
Pradeep: For mobile the diff peek becomes a stacked accordion. Make sure each accordion header has sufficient hit area (44px) and aria-controls to tie to the content.
Asha (PM): Summarize action items: Sam -> update copy for drawer title + CTA; Pradeep -> keyboard + accordion behavior and aria attributes; Nina -> add aria-live phrasing and coordinate with accessibility-bot tests; Me (Asha) -> include shortcut guidance in the release notes.
Nina: I'll also add a quick a11y checklist: focusable entry, aria-expanded on toggle, role=region + aria-labelledby on diff, aria-live update, debounce 300ms, no color-only cues, keyboard shortcut with modifier only.
accessibility-bot: Recommended test matrix: VoiceOver+Safari, NVDA+Firefox, TalkBack on Android, and keyboard-only navigation. Flag any screen reader announcement collisions.
Sam: I'll mock a small HTML snippet for Eng in a PR. ETA tomorrow morning.
Asha (PM): Thanks all, closing once PR is open. :thumbsup:
